deferred_source_units.source_text: They unjustly lay in ambush in narrow places and did not know a righteous road.
deferred_source_units.reason: The fresh Proverbs 1:11-16 lead was read in its actual native wording. It speaks of hiding a righteous man in the earth, taking property and avoiding the criminals' paths, but does not explicitly describe an ambush in narrow places. A connection resting only on the general metaphor of a wicked road was not retained; Job's native ambush wording remains intact.

deferred_source_units.source_text: The abyss said, ‘It is not in me,’ and the sea said, ‘It is not with me.’
deferred_source_units.reason: Deuteronomy 30:11-14 was read as a possible sea-and-instruction comparison. Its command is not across the sea and is near the hearer, whereas Job personifies the abyss and sea as denying possession of wisdom. The remaining shared sea imagery was insufficient for a particular retained relationship; the texts' different claims were not merged.

unresolved_candidates.source_text: They unjustly lay in ambush in narrow places and did not know a righteous road.
unresolved_candidates.reason: Job explicitly describes an unjust ambush in narrow places and ignorance of a righteous road. The native Proverbs text instead describes hiding a righteous man in the earth, seizing his property, and refusing the criminals' paths. It was not rewritten as an ambush proposal; the general violent-path association alone was not retained.

target_units.text: Come with us; share in bloodshed. Let us hide a righteous man in the earth unjustly;
let us swallow him alive like Hades and remove his memory from the earth.
Let us seize his costly property and fill our houses with spoils.
Cast your lot among us; let us all obtain a common purse, and let there be one moneybag for us.
Do not walk in the way with them; turn your foot away from their paths,
for their feet run toward evil, and they are quick to shed blood.

unresolved_candidates.source_text: The abyss said, ‘It is not in me,’ and the sea said, ‘It is not with me.’
unresolved_candidates.reason: The sea in Job denies that wisdom is with it. Deuteronomy says its command is not across the sea and is instead near the hearer. These concern different spatial claims and different subjects; shared sea imagery and the general question of instruction were not sufficient to retain a pair.

target_units.text: For this commandment which I command you this day is not excessively burdensome, neither is it far from you.
It is not in heaven above, that you should say, Who shall ascend for us into heaven, and fetch it for us, that we may hear it and do it?
Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, Who shall cross for us unto the other side of the sea, and fetch it for us, and make us hear it, that we may do it?
The word is very near you, in your mouth, and in your heart, and in your hands, that you may do it.
